text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening stance and closing restatement","quality":"thesis coherence","description":"It states a position early and returns to it at the end, giving the essay a clearer argumentative throughline."},{"evidence":"“if an accident occured... they wouldnt know who to blame”","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"It grounds the argument in a specific detail from the article instead of relying mostly on general opinion."},{"evidence":"“glitches and bugs... hacked and controlled from anywhere”","quality":"reasoned elaboration","description":"It extends the claim with additional consequences and explanations rather than simply asserting that the cars are bad."},{"evidence":"“the money factor would be a big issue”“smart roads instead of smart cars”","quality":"argument development","description":"It develops a more focused case by connecting the article's ideas to a concrete practical objection."},{"evidence":"mostly one controlled paragraph of argument","quality":"organization","description":"It is more tightly organized, with fewer digressions and a more direct progression from claim to support to conclusion."}]}
